responses.explanation: The evidence indicates that the confirmed net value loss for maize imports is close to 40%, which contradicts my previous claim of a 38.5-62.5% loss. Therefore, I concede this point.

While the confirmed net value loss for Midgard wheat is close to 40%, Tolan buyers have replaced part of the lost volume with wheat from Vanir, indicating that the overall impact may be mitigated. Additionally, a purchasing manager at a Midgard mill stated that they can replace some of the lost wheat, suggesting that the losses may not be as severe as indicated.
